steps.why_en: Only notice number, vehicle, place and offence date show; offence type, rule code and amount are not on this screen.
steps.why_id: Hanya notice number, kendaraan, tempat, dan tanggal offence yang tampil; tipe offence, rule code, dan amount tidak ada di layar ini.

steps.en: Screen shows the current processing stage
steps.why_en: The stage shown is the one at submission time and is not updated when the notice moves on.
steps.why_id: Stage yang tampil adalah stage saat submission dan tidak diperbarui ketika notice berpindah stage.

steps.en: Screen shows date and time of submission
steps.id: Layar menampilkan tanggal dan jam submission

steps.en: Screen shows owner, hirer and driver details
steps.id: Layar menampilkan detail owner, hirer, dan driver
steps.why_en: Submitter and furnished particulars show, but the notice's existing owner, hirer and driver records are not shown for comparison.
steps.why_id: Particulars submitter dan furnished tampil, tetapi data owner, hirer, dan driver yang sudah ada pada notice tidak tampil untuk dibandingkan.

steps.en: Officer can download any documentary proof submitted
steps.id: Officer dapat mengunduh documentary proof yang disubmit
